messages:
Samira S.: hey team :wave: I started today on Eng-Platform. Quick access request — can someone help get me the following?
- Console (staging): Feature Flags editor
- Console (prod): Readonly (view dashboards + logs, no flag edits)
- Admin panel: readonly (for investigating user issues)
I'm already SSO'd in via Okta (samira@example.com). Manager is Jess L. Thanks!

Jess L.: welcome Samira!! :tada: I can approve prod once you confirm you've completed the prod-access training (short course). Did you finish it?

Samira S.: yep finished just now, training ID PROD-ACCESS-2026 (screenshot uploaded to my profile).

morgan-admin: filing IT ticket now, one sec.

morgan-admin: Created ticket INC-2026-478 for console/admin access. Assigning to infra. ETA 1-2 business days for prod; staging should be quicker.

akash: I can add you to staging right away. Added you to `console-staging-ff-editors` — try editing the flag `new-user-onboard`. If you see a permissions error, ping me.

Samira S.: I can open staging console and edit the flag — looks good, thanks akash!

kate (security): small reminder — prod readonly requires: 1) manager approval (Jess confirmed above), 2) signed NDA (we have that), 3) acknowledgement of no-prod-data-copy. All set on our side after morgan applies the group change.

Jess L.: confirming approval for prod readonly (giving Samira view-only access).

morgan-admin: Updated INC-2026-478: added Samira to `console-prod-readers` via Okta SCIM. Command used:
```
scim patch --group console-prod-readers --add-member samira@example.com
```
Please verify you can view prod dashboards but cannot edit flags.

Samira S.: confirmed I can view prod dashboards and logs, edit buttons are disabled for flags. Looks correct. Thanks everyone! :rocket:

onboard-bot: Welcome Samira! Suggested next steps:
1) join #eng-platform and #eng-oncall
2) run the internal setup guide: https://internal.redwood/setup
3) claim your laptop asset in #people-ops

Samira S.: will do — appreciate the quick help! :smile:
